scope: Local Linux synthetic acceptance fixture, two distinguishable versions of the four-store set, one publisher and quiescent application data.
prediction: Every process exit before CURRENT replacement preserves the prior selection. Exit after replacement selects the complete new generation and leaves the prior generation restorable.
termination: Spawned publisher called os._exit(73) at each cut; parent checked the exit code. Operating system and storage remained online.
acceptance: Verify the selected manifest hash and store digests. Check one pending submission before application replay, equal lab receipt, transcript ref, course manifest and recommendation, duplicate submission and unchanged mastery.
limits: Test fixture only. The selector is local mutable metadata; candidate names are unique, so retry may leave duplicate or incomplete directories. No power failure, durable fsync ordering, writer concurrency, off-host custody or production deployment was exercised.
next: Implement and test a durable single-publisher contract on an isolated volume, including file and directory sync ordering, ambiguous commit reconciliation and safe retries. Keep independent off-host readback as a separate acceptance gate.
